baseline.head: b57b1efc98bda9ac37c75fe32d1d8b9618feea8c
baseline.inheritedWork: Existing 8B.1, 8D, and 8E edits/artifacts were present before this phase and preserved.
baseline.issue: Separate ordinary Inspect/Select cells choices coexisted with an ambiguous pointer-shaped Draw area action, detailed map popups duplicated inspector content, and Scope/Map Focus/Inspect focus occupied persistent toolbar width. Selection CTA/count copy could be read as a fixed target, and 390px controls wrapped into a tall block.

after.interaction: One explicit ordinary mode choice; contextual special tools replace those choices while armed; clear and fit have separate, named semantics.
after.entityDetail: Detailed Cell, gap, and recommendation map popups are removed. Inspector is authoritative; communication-path tooltip retains only the compact interface-family label.
after.visualization: Signal, Rays, and conditional one-select radio-quality metric are grouped as visualization controls. Scope and Map Focus share View; Layers stays separate.
after.selectionMessaging: Setup owns cluster progress, command bar owns next action, map control owns click mode, and transient status expires after 5 seconds.
after.responsive: Toolbar is one 44px row at desktop/tablet captures and 42px at 390px; no document horizontal overflow or measured toolbar/inspector, legend/inspector, View/legend, or View/zoom overlap in 15 post-change states.

inspectorLayout.1920: Push inspector; map toolbar and legend end at x=1588 with 12px before inspector at x=1600.
inspectorLayout.1600: Push inspector; toolbar and legend end at x=1268 with 12px before inspector at x=1280.
inspectorLayout.1440: Inspector overlays the right edge; toolbar and legend end at x=1108, exactly at inspector's left edge.
inspectorLayout.1280: Inspector uses the existing single-panel slot; task drawer is not stacked with it.
inspectorLayout.1024: Single-panel inspector layout; toolbar stays within map bounds.
inspectorLayout.768: One bottom sheet; Map key is collapsed while inspector occupies the lower region.
inspectorLayout.390: One bottom sheet; 42px map toolbar. When View is open, Map key and Leaflet zoom are temporarily hidden because they overlap the mobile View menu; both return when it closes.

before.directory: Existing Concept 8E and 8B.1 evidence, referenced in place to avoid duplicate binary assets.
before.provenance: Inspector screenshots are pre-8C Concept 8E captures; the setup image is the closest prior Concept 8B.1 setup-shell capture. They document the inherited UI but are not a newly captured pixel-paired baseline for every 8C toolbar state.

after.provenance: Captured from the post-change E2E evidence workflow; the corresponding exact measurements are in concept-8c-responsive-evidence.json.

bundle.warning: The existing Vite initial JavaScript chunk >500 kB advisory remains.

scopeBoundary: No Plan > Scenarios extraction, RF Diagnostics subview restructuring, Results, Run History, Data, Experiments, Building Entry, Core Lab, or marker-clustering work was implemented.
